title: What's New in v2.9.53
notes: 🚩 Championship Season Details Flag Fields: Added dedicated flag entry fields for both Our Alliance and Opponent Alliance directly inside the '⚙️ Season Details & Overall Record' top admin card.
⚡ Auto-Calculate Flags & Records: The 'Auto-Calculate' button now computes total tournament flag totals across all 5 battle rounds automatically alongside win/loss record.

🏆 Prominent Flag Summary Banner: The Public Alliance Championship header banner now displays a dedicated total flags pill summary (e.g. 🚩 16 Flags Captured | 🚩 9 Opponent Flags), and every round card renders styled flag count badges.
